cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got Mum's lunch visit in hand. Would you call this spoon polished, or shall I give it another pass?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You promised to clean the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A good visit starts with details. You decide on the forks; I'll trust your standard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've asked Mum to bring rubber gloves. She'll help you tackle the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, I've always favored a family effort. Pick a guest towel for her, would you? Any color you like, as long as we agree it looks welcoming.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims visit control; A3 hands B minor standards and A5 adopts family help as A philosophy while redirecting it to towel choice instead of cleaning.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 spoon approval and neglected promise cause A3 forks diversion; B4 cleaning helper causes A5 welcoming-towel discussion.

relationship.evidence: B2 names A responsibility and B4 provides real assistance; A quietly seeks participation in details instead.

heightening.evidence: A5 absorbs the solution to the major problem into another minor task, sustaining the evasion.

specificity.evidence: A1 lunch visit and B2 promised kitchen cleaning establish enough situation and stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 agreement about welcoming color is deliberately fussy rather than a detached punchline.
